camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000' --TagKey.1 test --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Removes tags from one or more Bastionhost instances. You can remove specific tag key-value pairs or all tags at once
description_zh: 为指定堡垒机实例批量解绑并删除标签
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000 --tag-key test --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource.

The only valid value is INSTANCE. This value indicates a Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。

唯一取值为INSTANCE，表示堡垒机实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the Bastionhost instance.

If you specify \`TagKey.N\`, you must set \`All\` to false to remove specific tags.

If you do not specify \`TagKey.N\`, set \`All\` to true to remove all tags. If you set \`All\` to false, no tags are removed
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否删除堡垒机实例上的全部标签。

设置TagKey.N时，All的值只能设置为false，删除某个标签。
未设置TagKey.N时，All设置为true，删除所有的标签。All设置为false，不删除标签
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

The value of N can be from 1 to 20.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

N的取值范围：1~20。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The key of the tag.

The value of N can be from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh:
实例的标签键。

N的取值范围：1~20
parameters.name: tag_key
